item.title: Tigers hold steady at #7; Boswell & Beadling enter NAIA rankings
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The Campbellsville University men's wrestling team maintained its #7 standing in the fifth regular-season edition of the NAIA Men's Wrestling Coaches' Top 25 Poll, released Thursday by the national office. Despite a challenging run at the NWCA National Duals, the Tigers secured 154 team points to remain a top-10 fixture.

item.title: Lady Tigers fall short in overtime thriller to #2 Wildcats
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – In a clash of NAIA heavyweights at the Powell Athletic Center, the #3 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers battled the #2 Bethel University Wildcats to a standstill through 40 minutes but ultimately fell short in overtime, dropping a 76-70 decision on Thursday evening. The loss moves Campbellsville to 16-2 on the season and 1-1 in Mid-South Conference play.

item.title: Kramer’s double-double not enough as Tigers drop MSC heartbreaker
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team saw a double-digit second-half lead slip away on Thursday night, falling to Mid-South Conference foe Bethel University (Tenn.), 78-75, inside the Powell Athletic Center.

item.title: Tigers use 3 pins to outmaneuver (RV) Georgetown
item.description: GEORGETOWN, Ky. – In a battle of the Tigers on the road, the #7 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team took on (RV) Georgetown College Friday night in Mid-South Conference action, coming away with a gritty 26-24 win.

item.title: #3 Lady Tigers fall to #5 Freed-Hardeman in top-5 clash
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The #3 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers hosted the #5 Freed-Hardeman University Lady Lions on Saturday afternoon for a highly anticipated Top-5 Mid-South Conference showdown. Despite controlling the interior and outscoring the Lady Lions 30-20 in the paint, Campbellsville struggled to contain Freed-Hardeman's perimeter shooting in the second half, falling 67-56.

item.title: #2 Lions pull away in second half to best Tigers
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team faced a daunting task on Saturday afternoon, hosting the NAIA's second-ranked team, the Freed-Hardeman University Lions. Despite an energetic start and a team-high 14 points from Marcellus Vail, the Tigers were unable to stifle the Lions' perimeter attack, falling 80-48 inside the Powell Athletic Center.

item.title: Tait pins, Craft dominates, but #5 Blue Raiders take team win on Senior Night
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The #17 Campbellsville University women's wrestling team welcomed Mid-South Conference rival #5 Lindsey Wilson College to the Hord Wrestling Facility on Saturday night for the annual "Battle of Highway 55." On a night dedicated to the program's seniors, the Tigers battled through a gauntlet of ranked match-ups but ultimately fell to the Blue Raiders, 33-11.

item.title: Tigers split squads battle Division I competition at Vanderbilt & Bellarmine
item.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn. / LOUISVILLE, Ky. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams faced a massive test of depth and talent this weekend, splitting squads to compete at the prestigious Vanderbilt Invitational in Nashville and the Bellarmine Open in Louisville.

item.title: Podium placements define Tiger performances at MSC Indoor Championships
item.description: MADISONVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University archery team competed at the Mid-South Conference Indoor Championships this weekend, earning podium finishes while facing a strong field of conference opponents.

item.title: #7 Tigers drop 19-18 decision to #9 Cumberlands
item.description: WILLIAMSBURG, Ky. – In a tightly contested Mid-South Conference showdown on the road, the #7 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team battled until the final whistle but came up just short, falling 19-18 to #9 University of the Cumberlands on Tuesday night.
